summary: Get Company Workflowable Object Instance Histories
description: Returns grouped workflow instance histories for a workflowable object (`tool_type` + `item_id`).

parameters.name: tool_type
parameters.description: Workflowable tool type. Supports external name (preferred) and class name (compatibility).

parameters.name: filters[activity_types][]
parameters.description: Optional activity filter (`comments`, `attachments`). When present, **future step events are not included** (linear templates only).

schema.description: Grouped workflow instance histories for a workflowable object

data.description: List of workflow instances and their corresponding histories

instance_id.description: Unique identifier of the workflow instance

name.description: Display name of the workflow template for this instance

started_at.description: Timestamp when the workflow instance was started

ended_at.description: Timestamp when the workflow instance ended

blocked_is_retriable.description: True when a blocked instance may recover via an instance refresh.

history.description: Ordered list of history events for this workflow instance

current_step_index.description: Zero-based index within the history array pointing to the current active step, or null when the instance has ended
